title: Igris harness distribution manifest
description: Per-project declaration of agent prompt harnesses to mechanically regenerate from canonical sources. Core owns this schema; each project ships its own data manifest. See FR-136.

_schema.description: free-form human field-doc block; ignored by tooling

version.description: Manifest format version. Bump only on a breaking schema change; FR-136 ships v1.

surfaces.description: FR-137: non-agent projection surfaces. 'skills' is fleshed out here (core-owned in surfaces-manifest.json, or personal via the FR-139 overlay). 'os_context' remains RESERVED for FR-140 (permissive). An absent or skills-only surfaces block validates. Additive flesh-out — no version bump (still v1). TD-191: `skills` is now an ARRAY of blocks (multi-source) — loaders normalize legacy single-object overlays to `[object]` on read so back-compat holds without a version bump.

os_context.description: RESERVED for FR-140 (rules+prompts OS-context projection). Permissive until FR-140 fleshes it out; an absent block is the normal case in FR-137.

skills_surface.description: FR-137/TD-191/FR-149/FR-151/FR-153: ONE skills projection block. Multiple coexist as elements of `surfaces.skills[]`; each carries its OWN source/layer/targets so personal blocks compile ALONGSIDE the core block. For personal blocks `source` points at a registry-vendored path (L-516 universal copy-vendor). Valid (type, method) pairs: claude/symlink, codex/symlink, gemini/symlink (registry-anchored per-skill symlinks). All three symlink targets vendor identically — the per-harness compiler walks the registry-vendored skill tree. The legacy codex/compiler (AGENTS.md aggregator) + gemini/converter (per-skill TOML) pairs were retired by FR-153. See L-519.

source.description: Skills root dir holding {skill}/SKILL.md entries. A leading '~' or an absolute path is used verbatim; otherwise resolved vs --project-root. Default ~/.igris/core/skills.

layer.description: FR-139 provenance seam: 'core' (declared in surfaces-manifest.json) or 'personal' (contributed by the FR-139 overlay).

path.description: symlink (claude/codex/gemini): output dir under which each <skill>/ becomes a symlink to its registry-vendored canonical (FR-149/FR-151/FR-153). The legacy compiler/converter methods were retired by FR-153.

layer.description: RESERVED / forward-compat for FR-139 (Layer-2 customization registry). Provenance only - the compiler enforces the Core/Personal boundary physically via separate base + overlay manifest files (see FR-136 plan section 2), NOT via this field. Defaults to 'core' when absent. FR-139 may write 'personal' (or a namespaced value) on overlay entries.

dir.description: canonical prompt dir, resolved relative to --project-root

body_exception.description: optional; basename of a body-exceptions/<name>.json sidecar

path.description: output harness path. Resolved per 3-case shape (FR-154): leading `~/` expands against $HOME, `/abs/...` is verbatim, otherwise relative to --project-root.
